## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, why it is needed, and any context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring or performance optimization

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and guidelines in `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] 100% Client-Side Privacy: No server endpoints, cloud uploads, or tracking of image files have been introduced.
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 warnings or errors.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds and exports static files cleanly.
- [ ] Any relevant documentation has been updated.
